description: This file declares the RuntimeManagerHandler class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including its nested RuntimeManagerNotification class. It provides interface declarations for managing runtime lifecycle events, such as starting, terminating, suspending, resuming, and retrieving stats for applications, as well as handling notifications related to runtime state changes.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing runtime application lifecycle, handling notifications, and interfacing with the runtime manager and event handler.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing the INotification interface to receive runtime state change notifications.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts or runs an application with specified parameters and target state.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the application instance identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes the application instance and sets its lifecycle state.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for the specified application instance.
